test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07384d063e18acafd51d0a969b70abf5c8602e8166b85a919e0aee751d2348c9.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The bottom elements and the first element of 2nd row shift anticlockwise.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d55c9f43c58ed69a9a63af3205ab3e877e74591a1c8c8cab1a8d3c92ab029244.png] 

2) Second box series → 

The 2nd row elements shift anticlockwise.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57824d0d6a80a934d062db63f6122a71561b03d7c8d5f55dac6ca488bbe60712.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36da97a4031110c3040af72655e9c284752807b78afd3d5c64809b5cf8cc9f87.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
